01 — About

How I work

“I work on the whole path of a feature: the interface, the API, the database and the Android app on top of it.”

I’m a full stack developer with about a year of experience building and maintaining web and mobile products at The House of Cre8r, including the KNI platform (web plus 2 Android apps), TransRentals and GreyAcademy.

I use AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT and Codex to move faster, and I review and test every change against what the project needs. When something breaks in production, I trace it through the UI, API and database before I fix it.
